label: Microsoft Users
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for Microsoft Graph user profiles and organizational hierarchy

tools.name: GetDirectReports
tools.description:
Get a user's direct reports from the organizational hierarchy.

Returns a paginated list of users and organizational contacts who report
directly to the specified user.

Requires a Microsoft 365 work or school account. Not available for
personal Microsoft accounts (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com).

parameters.name: user_identifier
parameters.description: The user's email address, UPN, or Microsoft user ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of direct reports to return per page.

parameters.name: pagination_token
parameters.description: Token from a previous response to get the next page of results.

output.description: List of the user's direct reports with their profiles

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: GetUserManager
tools.description:
Get a user's direct manager from the organizational hierarchy.

Returns the manager's profile data. If the user has no manager (e.g.,
top-level executives), returns a response indicating no manager was found.

Requires a Microsoft 365 work or school account. Not available for
personal Microsoft accounts (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com).

parameters.name: user_identifier
parameters.description: The user's email address, UPN, or Microsoft user ID. Use the email address from a calendar attendee or email participant.

output.description: The manager's profile including name, job title, department, and contact info

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: GetUserProfile
tools.description:
Look up one or more users by email address, UPN, or user ID.

Accepts a list of identifiers and automatically optimizes between single
and batch Graph API calls. Use this to enrich calendar attendees or email
participants with job titles, departments, and org data.

Requires a Microsoft 365 work or school account. Not available for
personal Microsoft accounts (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com).

parameters.name: user_identifiers
parameters.description: One or more email addresses, user principal names (UPNs), or Microsoft user IDs to look up. Email address is the most common identifier — use it when enriching calendar attendees or email participants. Max 20 per call.

output.description: Profiles for each resolved user, plus any identifiers that could not be found

tools.name: WhoAmI
tools.description:
Get information about the current user including name, email, job title,
department, office location, and tenant domain.

output.description: Get comprehensive user profile information for the signed-in user.

summary:
The Microsoft Users toolkit connects Arcade to the Microsoft Graph API, enabling LLMs to look up user profiles and traverse organizational hierarchies within a Microsoft 365 tenant.

## Capabilities

- **Profile lookup**: Resolve one or more users by email address, UPN, or user ID; retrieves job title, department, office location, and tenant domain. Automatically optimizes between single and batch Graph API calls.
- **Current user identity**: Retrieve the authenticated user's own profile, including name, email, job title, department, and office location.
- **Org hierarchy traversal**: Walk the organizational chart in both directions — fetch a user's direct reports (paginated, including organizational contacts) or their direct manager.
- **Contextual enrichment**: Designed for use alongside calendar and email tools to enrich attendee or participant data with org metadata.

> **Note:** All tools require a Microsoft 365 work or school account. Personal Microsoft accounts (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com) are not supported.

## OAuth

This toolkit authenticates via OAuth 2.0 using **Microsoft** as the identity provider. See the [Arcade Microsoft auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/microsoft) for setup details, including how to register an app in Azure and configure the provider in Arcade.
